summary: Delegated portal login blocked by identity-alias split after SCIM normalization
description: Issue summary: Several engineers reported 403s when attempting to use the Delegated Developer Portal (devtools.redwood.com) after a scheduled SCIM attribute normalization run. Impact: ~12 users (engineering, platform) unable to perform impersonation or access feature-flag tooling; blocks oncall troubleshooting. Environment: production / us-west / private identity sync from Okta -> SCIM -> identity-proxy. Observed behavior: New and existing users receive 403 with 'identity_alias_not_found' when hitting /v1/impersonate. Expected behavior: Identity alias normalization should preserve existing alias mappings or provide deterministic alias remapping so delegated sessions work. Triage summary: Not a console bug; root cause appears to be attribute canonicalization change in SCIM pipeline that split the single 'ident' claim into two aliases for a subset of accounts, causing token->alias lookup failures in identity-proxy.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Create or identify user with legacy 'ident' claim (prior to normalization).
2) Trigger SCIM normalization job (manual or scheduled run).
3) Attempt to initiate an impersonation session via devtools portal UI, or curl POST /v1/impersonate with Authorization header from Okta session.
4) Observe 403 with error code 'identity_alias_not_found' in response body and identity-proxy logs showing 'resolved_aliases=0'.
logs: identity-proxy (2026-03-12T09:12:04Z) TRACE id=trace-9a7: lookup_alias_for_token(token=xxx) -> not found; returning 403
scim-sync (2026-03-12T08:45:12Z) INFO job=normalization: user=eng.alex@redwood.com changed ident->[eng.alex, alex.eng]
comments: Support (Aisha): Customer reported via #internal-access Slack at 2026-03-12T09:20 saying 'can't impersonate, 403 identity_alias_not_found'. Added initial ticket and escalated to Platform SRE.
SRE (Priya): Confirmed 403s and reproduced locally using staging SCIM snapshot. Initial hypothesis: SCIM canonicalization created duplicate aliases and identity-proxy lookup index was not updated.
Auth (Diego): Found a recent change in scim-service (PR #482) that changed 'ident' normalization rules; added link to PR and recommended rolling back the normalization for affected accounts.

SRE (Priya): Applied a hotfix mapping in identity-proxy to accept both alias forms (deployed canary to us-west). Verified immediate reduction in 403s. Pushed full rollout and informed support to validate.
Support (Aisha): Customer confirmation: 12 users reported success after 2026-03-13T14:00. Closing follow-up tasks to create runbook and add reconciliation job.
Product (Marcel): Requested postmortem items: add a feature flag around SCIM normalization and an automated smoke test for delegated-portal impersonation after sync runs.
investigation_notes: Checked SCIM normalization commit history: scim-service@main introduced new tokenization for 'ident' on 2026-03-11 in PR #482.

Identity-proxy stores alias index keyed by 'primary_alias'. When normalization split the alias into two values we failed to migrate primary_alias for ~1.8% of users (all with legacy dots in username).
Reproduction: Used staging SCIM snapshot + live identity-proxy to repro 403; adding a secondary_alias mapping in-memory allowed lookup to succeed.
Metrics: error rate for /v1/impersonate spiked from 0.02% to 7.4% between 08:40-09:20 UTC on 2026-03-12 in us-west. Traces linked: trace-9a7, trace-1f3, trace-2b9.
Hypothesis validated by hotfix: adding reverse-mapping immediately reduced errors to baseline within 12 minutes in canary region.
resolution: Root cause: SCIM normalization change created a second alias variant for a subset of users without migrating the primary_alias index used by identity-proxy. identity-proxy treated the normalized alias as a new alias and did not resolve tokens issued before normalization.

Immediate workaround: Deployed an identity-proxy hotfix (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/identity-proxy/pull/482) to accept both alias formats and perform a best-effort reverse lookup for 72 hours.

Permanent fix: Rolled back the normalization rollout, authored targeted reconciliation job to unify aliases and update primary_alias for affected accounts, and reworked the scim normalization feature behind a feature flag to do staged migrations.
Rollout notes: Hotfix rolled canary -> full region on 2026-03-13 14:00 UTC. Reconciliation job ran 2026-03-13 16:30 and fixed 1,147 accounts. No further 403 spikes observed as of 2026-03-14.

Follow-ups: (a) Create runbook: 'scim-normalization-impersonation-check' (Confluence page created) (b) Add smoke test to deploy pipeline that performs an impersonation attempt post SCIM run (c) Add monitoring alert on impersonation/403 delta > 0.5% above baseline.
Status: Resolved and monitoring active. Ticket closed pending retrospective documentation.
